meta.title: Europe in Numbers: compare countries with Eurostat data
meta.description: Compare European countries on unemployment, GDP per capita, renewable energy, life expectancy and more, with official Eurostat data. Every view is a shareable link.

header.tagline: Compare European countries with official Eurostat data.

controls.heading: What to compare
controls.countriesHint: Up to {max} countries, shown in the chart over time.
controls.maxReached: You are comparing {max} countries, the maximum. Remove one to add another.
controls.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No countries selected} one {# country selected} other {# countries selected}}

unemployment.name: Unemployment rate
unemployment.description: Unemployed people as a share of the labour force, ages 15 to 74.

gdp-per-capita.name: GDP per capita
gdp-per-capita.description: Gross domestic product per person, in euros at current prices.

renewable-energy.name: Renewable energy share
renewable-energy.description: Share of renewable sources in gross final energy consumption.

life-expectancy.name: Life expectancy at birth
life-expectancy.description: Years a newborn is expected to live if current mortality rates stay the same.

internet-use.name: Internet use
internet-use.description: Share of people aged 16 to 74 who used the internet in the last 3 months.

housing-cost.name: Housing cost overburden
housing-cost.description: Share of people living in households that spend more than 40% of their disposable income on housing.

inflation.name: Inflation (HICP)
inflation.description: Annual average change in consumer prices, measured by the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices.

employment-rate.name: Employment rate
employment-rate.description: Employed people as a share of the population aged 20 to 64.

invalid_indicator.title: This indicator is not available
invalid_indicator.body: The link may be out of date. Pick an indicator from the list.

no_data.title: Eurostat has no data for this indicator
no_data.body: Eurostat answered, but without any values. Try another indicator.

bad_request.title: Eurostat did not accept the request
bad_request.body: The dataset may have changed. Try another indicator, or come back later.

not_found.title: Eurostat could not find this dataset
not_found.body: It may have been renamed or retired. Try another indicator.

too_large.title: The request was too large for Eurostat
too_large.body: This should not happen. Try another indicator, or come back later.

upstream.title: Eurostat is having problems
upstream.body: Its service returned an error. This is usually temporary, so try again in a minute.

timeout.title: Eurostat is taking too long to answer
timeout.body: Its service may be busy. Try again in a minute.

network.title: Could not reach the data service
network.body: Check your internet connection and try again.

malformed.title: The data came back in an unexpected format
malformed.body: Eurostat may have changed its response. Try another indicator, or come back later.

status.noCountries: Add at least one country to see how it changed over time.
status.noDataForSelection: None of the selected countries has data between {from} and {to}. Try a wider period or another country.
status.noDataForYear: No country has data for {year}. Try another year.
status.missingCountries: No data in this period for: {countries}.

chart.trendSummary: Line chart comparing {countries} from {from} to {to}. The table view lists every value.
chart.rankingSummary: Bar chart of {count} countries in {year}, from highest to lowest. Highest: {top}. Lowest: {bottom}.
chart.selectedHint: The countries you are comparing are marked with ◆.
chart.selectedHintMap: The countries you are comparing have a dark outline.
chart.keyboardHint: Use the left and right arrow keys to read the values year by year.
chart.rankingKeyboardHint: Use the up and down arrow keys to read each country in turn.

map.legendTitle: Value ranges (each holds about a fifth of the countries)
map.summary: Map of {count} countries in {year}. Highest: {top}. Lowest: {bottom}. Switch to the table to read every value.

table.flagsNote: Marked values carry a Eurostat note:
